job.title: Senior AI Infrastructure Engineer - GPU Cloud Platform
job.description:
Senior AI Infrastructure Engineer – GPU Cloud Platform

London (Hybrid, 2 days in office) | £90,000 – £120,000 | Permanent

The company

A VC-backed AI cloud provider that gives AI companies and research teams access to large-scale GPU compute. They’ve raised Series A funding, have around 60 people, and are scaling their platform across multiple data centres in the UK and Europe. Customers range from early-stage AI startups to enterprise ML teams running large training and inference workloads.

The role

You’ll join a small, senior infrastructure team that owns the platform customers run their workloads on. This is a hands-on role with real ownership. You’ll help shape how the platform scales as GPU capacity grows over the next 12–18 months.

What you’ll be doing

  • Building and operating Kubernetes clusters for GPU workloads across bare-metal and cloud environments
  • Managing GPU scheduling, multi-tenancy and resource isolation using tools such as the NVIDIA GPU Operator
  • Automating provisioning and configuration with Terraform, Ansible and GitOps (ArgoCD/Flux)
  • Improving observability and reliability with Prometheus, Grafana and alerting on high-value compute
  • Working on networking and storage performance for distributed training (InfiniBand/RoCE, high-throughput storage)
  • Supporting customers and internal ML engineers to get workloads running efficiently
  • Taking part in a fair, well-supported on-call rota

What they’re looking for

  • 5+ years in platform, infrastructure or SRE roles
  • Deep production Kubernetes experience, ideally including operators or custom controllers
  • Strong Terraform / infrastructure as code skills
  • Solid Linux and networking fundamentals
  • Go or Python for tooling and automation
  • Experience with AWS, GCP, Azure or on-prem environments

Nice to have

  • GPU infrastructure experience (NVIDIA, CUDA drivers, DCGM)
  • Slurm or HPC backgrounds
  • Bare-metal or data-centre experience
  • Exposure to Ray, Kubeflow or distributed training workloads

Please note: Applicants must have the right to work in the UK. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

Interested? Apply directly or email max@neartechsearch.com for a confidential conversation and the full job spec.

job.title: Application Developer / Full Stack Software Engineer
job.description:
Full Stack Software Engineer

  • Job Title: Full Stack Software Engineer
  • Salary: £60,000–£70,000 (dependent on experience)
  • Location: UK | Hybrid working (details to be confirmed)

Ready to build software that puts cutting-edge AI into the hands of real-world users?
We are working with an innovative technology business developing advanced artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions for challenging real-world applications. Working alongside highly skilled software engineers and AI specialists, you'll help turn sophisticated research into practical software used by organisations operating in demanding environments. This is an opportunity to take ownership of meaningful development projects, influence technical decisions and build applications that deliver genuine operational value.

The Role
The Application Developer / Full Stack Software Engineer will design and develop high-performance applications that make advanced computer vision technology accessible, intuitive and effective for end users.
Rather than building AI models, you'll focus on the software and interfaces that bring their capabilities to life, supporting everything from large-scale image analysis to operational deployments.

Role Highlights

The Application Developer / Full Stack Software Engineer will:

  • Design and deliver modern full stack applications with responsive, user-friendly interfaces.
  • Build tools for searching, analysing, enhancing and reviewing large volumes of imagery and video.
  • Develop visualisation capabilities for AI outputs, model comparisons and performance statistics.
  • Work alongside Python, C++ and machine learning specialists to turn technical concepts into usable products.
  • Contribute to architecture, product development, customer demonstrations and operational deployments.



You Will Need

  • At least 3 years' commercial experience developing full stack applications.
  • Strong front-end knowledge covering HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, jQuery and AJAX.
  • Practical experience with Python web frameworks such as Flask or Django, alongside MongoDB or similar NoSQL databases.
  • Understanding of data lake technologies such as Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, Databricks or Snowflake.
  • Good knowledge of software architecture, Git, CI/CD, automated testing and production-quality development.

Experience with image or video applications, GIS, streaming technologies, event-driven architectures, Unreal Engine 5 or defence and security environments would be advantageous.
A degree or postgraduate qualification in Computer Science is desirable, although equivalent commercial experience will also be considered.

Why You'll Love It

  • Work alongside talented AI researchers and experienced software engineers.
  • Build applications connected to advanced computer vision and machine learning.
  • Influence architecture, technology choices and product direction.
  • Take ownership of projects with visible outcomes and genuine customer impact.
  • Develop your expertise across modern full stack technologies and emerging AI applications.

Security: Candidates must be eligible to obtain UK security clearance, including BPSS, with SC clearance or above desirable.

Employment: Full-time, permanent. Contract opportunities may also be considered.

Ready to take the next step? Apply today to join an ambitious technology business where your engineering expertise will help transform advanced AI into practical solutions. We are committed to promoting equality of opportunity for all employees and job applicants. In line with the Equality Act 2010, we strive to create and maintain a working environment in which everyone is able to make the best use of their skills, free from discrimination or harassment, and in which all decisions are based on merit.

Due to a high number of applicants, we are only able to respond to successful candidates.

  • Participate in technical planning, design discussions and code reviews.
  • Learn and apply software engineering best practices while collaborating with experienced colleagues.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Solid foundations in machine learning and deep learning, gained through a degree, personal projects, internships or previous employment.
  • Hands-on experience with PyTorch; TensorFlow is also beneficial.

Desirable Experience
